title: Find Departments That Have Employees
description: Use EXISTS to find departments that have at least one employee.

data.text: Write a query to list department names that have at least one employee.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT DepartmentID, DepartmentName
FROM Departments d
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Employees e
    WHERE e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID
);

data.title: Explanation
data.text: EXISTS checks if the subquery returns any rows. It stops at the first match, making it efficient for semi-joins. SELECT 1 is conventional — the column is irrelevant; EXISTS only checks for row existence.
